entities.name: Robert S. Garnett
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Selden Garnett was a nineteenth-century politician and lawyer from Virginia. He was the brother of James M. Garnett and the first cousin of Charles F. Mercer. He served as a member of the United States House of Representatives from 1817 to 1827.
